title: LOLPlay: Benchmarking Real-Time Visual Agents in League of Legends
abstract: arXiv:2611.03685v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Visual agents need to coordinate reasoning and action while their environment evolves during inference. We introduce LOLPlay, a benchmark in native League of Legends with 36 champion-specific tasks spanning resource management, combat, cooperation, and objectives. Agents interact through screenshots and mouse-keyboard actions; automated initialization and 82 executable subgoal checks distinguish partial progress from completion. Across 324 task evaluations of three models at three reasoning-effort settings, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate of 25.0% at low and medium effort, and the highest subgoal success rate of 40.3% at medium effort. However, high effort improves neither metric over low effort for any model. For Astra, longer requests leave fewer interaction rounds, suggesting a cost to additional reasoning in real-time control. translated_title: LOLPlay：英雄联盟中实时视觉智能体的基准测试
translated_abstract: 视觉智能体需要在推理过程中环境持续变化的情况下协调推理与行动。我们推出了LOLPlay，这是一个基于原生《英雄联盟》的基准测试，包含36个英雄专属任务，涵盖资源管理、战斗、合作与目标等类别。智能体通过截图和鼠标键盘操作与环境交互；自动化初始化和82个可执行的子目标检查能够区分部分进展与任务完成。在对三个模型在三种推理努力设置下进行的324次任务评估中，GPT-6 Astra在低和中推理努力下取得了最高的任务成功率25.0%，并在中推理努力下取得了最高的子目标成功率40.3%。然而，对任何模型而言，高推理努力在这两项指标上均未优于低推理努力。对于Astra，更长的请求会减少可用交互轮次，这表明在实时控制中进行额外推理存在代价。轨迹分析揭示了子目标组合不完整以及在目标变化后仍执行动作等问题。
tldr: 本文提出了首个基于原生《英雄联盟》的实时视觉智能体基准LOLPlay，通过36个英雄任务和82个可执行子目标检查发现，最强模型GPT-6 Astra任务成功率仅25.0%，且更高的推理努力不但没有提升表现，反而因延长响应时间而损害实时控制能力。
en_tdlr: LOLPlay is a benchmark for real-time visual agents in native League of Legends, featuring 36 champion-specific tasks with 82 executable subgoal checks, revealing that even the best model (GPT-6 Astra) achieves only 25.0% task success and that higher reasoning effort degrades real-time performance by reducing available interaction rounds.
